unconditionalNewFacts: R(3,2) = 3 and R(3,3) >= 6 (the latter modulo Ramsey's theorem, absent from Mathlib) recomputed from the spec's own definition - faithfulness controls the spec did not have; the spec proved only R(3,1) = 1.
IsRamseyBound is upward closed in the vertex count (isRamseyBound_mono_n) - this is what makes the spec's `sInf` the correct operator, and it was unproved in the spec.
Conjecture_pgm_quarter_is_truth and Conjecture_c_eq_half cannot both hold (conjecture_pgm_and_half_incompatible) - no literature input whatsoever.
Convergence of R(3,k)*log k/k^2 to c is EQUIVALENT to the two-sided epsilon-sandwich against k^2/log k at that same c (tendsto_iff_two_sided_bounds) - no literature input.
open: TARGET Question - NOT proved, NOT refuted. Open in the source (prize $250).

TARGET Conjecture_pgm_quarter_is_truth - NOT refuted unconditionally. Its negation is reduced to ONE cited paper (not_conjecture_pgm_of_cjms needs Campos-Jenssen-Michelen-Sahasrabudhe c >= 1/3; not_conjecture_pgm_of_hhkp needs Hefty-Horn-King-Pfender c >= 1/2). Neither paper is formalized.

TARGET Conjecture_c_eq_half - NOT proved. Given the HHKP lower bound as a hypothesis it is EXACTLY equivalent to the matching upper bound R(3,k) <= (1/2 + o(1)) k^2/log k (conjecture_c_eq_half_iff_upper_of_hhkp). That upper bound is the whole residue.
OBSTRUCTION 1 (analysis, closed): none. The scale/ratio translation is sealed both directions.

OBSTRUCTION 2 (literature, open): shearer_upper_bound - R(3,k) <= (1 + o(1)) k^2/log k. Unformalized. Improving its constant from 1 to 1/2 is, by conjecture_c_eq_half_iff_upper_of_hhkp, the entire remaining content of the c = 1/2 conjecture.

OBSTRUCTION 3 (literature, open): hefty_horn_king_pfender_lower_bound - c >= 1/2. Unformalized. lower_bound_of_witness_family types it as a pure construction problem: a family of triangle-free graphs on n(k) vertices with independence number < k and n(k) >= (1/2 - eps) k^2/log k.

OBSTRUCTION 4 (Mathlib gap): Ramsey's theorem is absent, so (RamseySet s t).Nonempty is carried as a hypothesis on every statement that needs sInf to be a real minimum (R_mono_left, R_le_iff_of_nonempty, lt_R_of_witness, le_R_of_nonempty, six_le_R_three_three). Proving finite Ramsey would discharge all of them.

OBSTRUCTION 5 (not attempted): R(3,3) <= 6. The upper half needs the neighbourhood pigeonhole argument on Fin 6; `decide` is not available because CliqueFree carries no Decidable instance on this rev and 2^15 graphs is out of kernel range regardless.
apiDriftObserved: SimpleGraph.CliqueFree.comap takes H.IsContained G, and IsContained is Nonempty (G.Copy H) - NOT Nonempty (G <-g H). Worked around by proving cliqueFree_comap from Finset.map / Finset.card_map, with no containment API at all.
SimpleGraph's loopless field is Std.Irrefl Adj (a class), not a bare Irreflexive - `loopless := by decide` fails, `loopless := <by decide>` works.
No Decidable instance for SimpleGraph.CliqueFree - `by decide` cannot be used on it. Extract the edges first, then decide the residual Fin-indexed statement.
